_corpus: The real artifact: what `wg.sh --userspace --forward 2222:10.9.0.2:22` writes on a customer machine -- the no-root mode of Aloecraft-org/diluvium-drt#25 §3, arriving in a customer-facing script. Same provenance as `wg.json` beside this (discofetch `126b409`, run against v0.6.0rc1, `wg check: ok`), and six lines different from it: no `interface`, and `mode`, `expose` and `forward` instead. `expose` defaults to this machine's sshd and is `--expose none`-able; `forward` is repeatable, and absent rather than `[]` when `--forward` is not given. No example in this repository exercises this shape, which is why it is here.
_this: /home/you/.config/discofetch/wg.json -- one end of a punched WireGuard tunnel. Written by https://discofetch.net/wg.sh. The peer is deliberately not named here: the rendezvous room supplies it at run time.
